footprint.label: PIC-12
footprint.note: PIC's official 12-county footprint, matching the cluster-health dashboard. Chosen for federal-data pages so figures reconcile.
footprint.differs: Excludes Crawford, Huron, Richland and Tuscarawas, which the vault's NEO-14 includes.

meta.row: one (year, county, NAICS) cell; weekly_wage is average weekly wage per covered job, not a salary and not per person

measures.vs_us: county weekly wage ÷ the same industry nationally
measures.vs_local_all: county weekly wage ÷ that county's all-industry average — does the cluster pay above its own town

meta.caution: Average weekly wage moves with hours and with the mix of occupations, not only with pay rates.
